notes.title: 0.8.9b update: controls and convenience
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020444/b85019ab4ce68b41fe915873186c8419bab644dd.jpg
 Buttons guide added
 Directional teleport — teleport system can modify playarea orientation
 Car respawn — car can be easily reset, if out of reach or turned over
 Input improvements — no need to click to use teleport, "X" button can be used for reverse (Oculus only)
